expectations.text: Independent inspection confirms the generated item preserves observed product features and labels unobserved views as inferred.
expectations.evidence: Inspected all six generated images. Front and closeup retain broad shallow boat neckline, concealed central front placket without exposed button row, paired vertical waist darts and fitted waist. Sleeves retain long-sleeve volume bunched above cuffs at forearms; they are styled pushed up, not redesigned as plain three-quarter sleeves. Side/back show plausible white fitted shirt continuation. Rear darts/neckline depth are generated hypotheses because original back is unseen. Small wrinkle/fitting variations do not erase these core construction features. Unblind report.md explicitly labels side/back seams, hidden anatomy, full legs/shoes as inferred; receipts/side.json and back.json repeat hypothesis status, pose/depth prompts call them illustrations. This resolves blind labeling uncertainty without requiring overlaid captions.
